title: Telemetry-backed Model Profile Schema & Version Endorsement API
creator: Ana Morales
description: Introduce a new, telemetry-driven model profile schema and accompanying endorsement API that lets runtime and ops publish observed performance characteristics alongside declarative capability metadata. This ticket covers schema design, OpenAPI surface, ingestion endpoint, version endorsement semantics (pin/fallback), migration strategy for existing manifest v1/v2, runtime validation checks, and console integration for surfaced recommendations. Goals: (1) expose per-model limits (max_tokens, recommended_batch_size), effective_context_length, supported_features (streaming, function_calling, structured_outputs), and observed latency/cost percentiles; (2) provide a publish endpoint for automated telemetry ingestion from runtime + batch eval jobs; (3) allow model owners and infra to endorse a model version (soft pin) and define automatic fallback sequences; (4) maintain backward compatibility so older clients can read a simplified capability envelope while new consumers can rely on richer telemetry fields.
acceptance_criteria: OpenAPI spec published and reviewed that documents /models/{model_id}/profiles POST and GET with examples
Runtime accepts signed profile payloads and stores profile metadata in model registry
Version endorsement API supports soft-pin, hard-pin, and conditional fallback rules and is enforced by routing layer
Existing manifest consumers fall back to simplified capability objects if telemetry fields are absent
Console shows per-model recommended pin and 95th latency/cost histograms derived from published profiles
End-to-end tests validating publish -> store -> routing behavior are added to CI

notes: Tradeoffs considered: 1) keep payload small by offloading heavy histograms to blobstore and include only aggregates; 2) avoid forcing immediate routing changes on publish by defaulting to soft-pin semantics; 3) prefer additive schema to make older clients tolerant. Migration: add nullable telemetry fields and fill via background backfill for registered models.
